comment: Free-to-play allowlist for the WorldWalker pathfinder, RuneScape 3 (not Old School). Each zone is an axis-aligned box of game tiles (inclusive bounds; x east, y north; plane_min..plane_max) that the RS3 wiki documents as free-to-play land. Any tile not inside a zone, or inside a members_holes box, is treated as members-only, so missing F2P land fails closed (the bot refuses to walk there) rather than routing a free player into members content. Drafted 2026-10-07 from runescape.wiki wikitext plus the walkable-area grid of the shipped worldwalker.wwa; see docs/f2p-zones.md for per-box evidence and doubts.

zones.name: Misthalin and Asgarnia core
zones.source: https://runescape.wiki/w/Misthalin + https://runescape.wiki/w/Asgarnia + https://runescape.wiki/w/Lumbridge + https://runescape.wiki/w/Varrock + https://runescape.wiki/w/Falador + https://runescape.wiki/w/Draynor_Village + https://runescape.wiki/w/Edgeville
zones.note: Lumbridge, Draynor, Varrock, Grand Exchange, Edgeville, Barbarian Village, Falador, Rimmington, Port Sarim, Taverley (east of x=2880), Goblin Village, Ice Mountain, Edgeville Monastery, Draynor Manor, Champions' Guild, Crafting Guild, Archaeology Campus/Varrock Dig Site, Exam Centre, Silvarea, Paterdomus (west bank), Lumber Yard site, Jolly Boar Inn, Al Kharid north of y=3158. West edge x=2880 keeps Entrana (x<=2878) out; east edge x=3398 stays west of the River Salve (Morytania walkable tiles start at x=3400 near y=3364); further east strips follow the river bank; north edge y=3519 is the Wilderness wall.

zones.name: Misthalin east bank strip (Kharid-et)
zones.note: Kharid-et Dig Site members=No, map 3367,3189 ('east of where Al Kharid stands today'). No Morytania tiles below y=3205.

zones.name: Misthalin east bank strip (Al Kharid to Exam Centre)
zones.note: River Salve page: location Misthalin; Morytania walkable tiles start at x>=3414 in these rows (measured on the bake).

zones.name: Misthalin east bank strip (Digsite)
zones.note: Morytania tiles start at x>=3406 in these rows.

zones.name: Paterdomus and Silvarea east end
zones.note: Paterdomus infobox members=No, location 'Misthalin/Morytania', map 3411,3492; Priest in Peril became F2P on 9 October 2017. Edge x=3416 keeps the temple; the strip x 3417-3426 east of the temple is left out (approximate: the members boundary into Morytania is not mapped on the wiki).

zones.name: Misthalin east bank strip (north)
zones.note: Morytania tiles start at x>=3408 here.

zones.name: Asgarnia and Misthalin south coast
zones.note: Mudskipper Point (2994,3116), Port Sarim south, Wizards' Tower (3104,3160) and Lumbridge Swamp south. West edge x=2960 keeps south Karamja out; east edge x=3195 stops short of desert tiles (x>=3200, y<=3128) that belong to the members desert.

zones.name: Lumbridge Swamp east / Al Kharid west
zones.note: Gap between the south-coast box and Al Kharid. Desert tiles of the members desert occur only at y<=3128 here.

zones.name: Kharid-et south approach
zones.note: North of the members fence; desert tiles connected to the southern desert occur at x<=3358 or y<=3145 here.

zones.name: Al Kharid south strip
zones.note: Al Kharid town south of y=3158 and the approach to Shantay Pass. Kharidian Desert page: 'Al Kharid is accessible by all players alike, but the desert south of the Shantay Pass is restricted to members only.' East edge x=3328 stops before desert tiles (x>=3331, y<=3157) that are only connected to the southern desert.

zones.name: Shantay Pass north side
zones.note: The pass building and its north approach. South edge y=3117 is the gate tile (pass transition 3303,3117 -> 3304,3115). max_y raised from 3133 to 3135 (2026-10-07): the next box north (Al Kharid south strip) starts at y=3136, and the two rows between were in no box, which cut the pass off from Al Kharid; no walkable desert tile joins the southern desert there.

zones.name: Taverley west (to White Wolf Mountain foot)
zones.note: Plane 0 only: plane 1 above this strip holds the White Wolf Mountain gnome glider landing (members). Path to the Land of Snow portal (2853,3461) and the Burthorpe mine cave (2875,3502). White Wolf Mountain page: the mountain 'forms part of the border between the free-to-play and members areas'; the wolves side beyond the cave is members.

zones.name: Taverley west (middle)
zones.note: Stepped edge: Kandarin (Catherby side) walkable tiles reach x=2859 at these rows.

zones.name: Taverley west (south)
zones.note: Stepped edge: Kandarin tiles reach x=2864 at these rows.

zones.name: Burthorpe
zones.note: Burthorpe, Burthorpe Castle, Warriors' Guild (2857,3542), Burthorpe Troll Cave entrance (2878,3575). North edge y=3577 keeps Death Plateau (2860,3591; members) out. Approximate: walkable land north-west of Burthorpe (x 2826-2850, y 3578-3595) is left out because I could not confirm it is F2P.

zones.name: Wilderness (south)
zones.note: Wilderness page infobox members=No; the Deep Wilderness 'was originally accessible to members only, but following an update on 9 October 2017, it was opened to free players'. East edge x=3389 keeps the land east of the River Salve mouth out. Fort Forinthry is carved out as holes.

zones.name: Wilderness (north, incl. Deep Wilderness)
zones.note: West edge x=2944 is the Troll Country border (Troll Country page members=Yes). Includes Red Dragon Isle ('now accessible to free players'), Lava Maze, Deserted Keep, Rogues' Castle, Mage Arena. Agility course is a hole.

zones.name: Daemonheim peninsula
zones.note: Daemonheim infobox members=No, map 3449,3714. The Daemonheim Dig Site (3449,3724) is members content but on land free players walk; not a hole.

zones.name: Musa Point (north-east Karamja)
zones.note: Karamja page: 'Musa Point is the north eastern part of Karamja, and is the only part of Karamja that free-to-play players can access, apart from the Karamja-Crandor dungeon.' Includes the volcano (2850,3172).

zones.name: Crandor
zones.note: Crandor infobox members=No; 'A few tiles on the western side of the island aren't accessible in free-to-play worlds' - west edge pulled in from x=2814 to 2820 (approximate).

zones.name: Elvarg's lair (Crandor and Karamja Dungeon)
zones.note: Redirects to Elvarg's lair, members=No; entrances 2834,3258 and 2856,3167.

zones.name: Dwarven Mine
zones.note: Map centre 3012,9792. West edge x=2971 keeps Taverley Dungeon (members, x<=2970) out.

zones.name: Mining Guild
zones.note: Map centre 3036,9745 (needs 60 Mining).

zones.name: Edgeville Dungeon
zones.note: Map centre 3120,9913. The Wilderness part beyond the members gate is a hole.

zones.name: Varrock Sewers
zones.note: Map centre 3218,9889. West part (x<3226, deadly red spiders/moss giants, only reachable via the members pipe in the bake) left out.

zones.name: Draynor Sewers
zones.note: Map centre 3104,9670.

zones.name: Lumbridge Castle cellar
zones.note: Trapdoor 3209,3216 -> 3208,9616. The Dorgesh-Kaan tunnels beyond need The Lost Tribe (members) and are not included.

zones.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon (east)
zones.note: South edge y=9559 keeps the skeletal wyvern chamber (members only) out.

zones.name: Forinthry Dungeon (north)
zones.note: Map centre 3075,10115; members=No (revenants). Split in two to avoid a solid filler block (area 49628) at x<=3071, y<=10113.

zones.name: Forinthry Dungeon (south)
zones.note: See north part.

zones.name: Lava Maze Dungeon (east part)
zones.note: 'The smaller eastern area of the dungeon, accessible by free players, is reached through the western entrance' (ladder 3017,3849 -> 3069,10257).

zones.name: Paterdomus mausoleum (to the Holy barrier)
zones.note: Silvarea page: free players can go 'as far as the Holy barrier in the Mausoleum under Paterdomus, which can only be passed by members'.

zones.name: War's Retreat
zones.note: 'The hub is accessible to free-to-play players.' Portal 3105,3310 -> 3294,10127.

zones.name: Lumbridge Catacombs
zones.note: 'a free-to-play dungeon that was released along with The Blood Pact'. Entrance 3247,3198 -> 3877,5526 (plane 1).

zones.name: King Black Dragon's Lair
zones.note: Map 2272,4696. F2P page: KBD achievements 'can be completed in free-to-play'.

zones.name: Mage Arena bank
zones.note: 'Unlike the Mage Arena minigame itself, this bank area is accessible to free-to-play players.'

zones.name: Burthorpe mine
zones.note: members=No; entrance 2873,3502.

zones.name: Burthorpe Troll Cave
zones.note: members=No; entrance 2878,3575.

zones.name: Burthorpe Games Room
zones.note: members=No; entrance 2893,3569.

zones.name: Air altar
zones.note: members=No; exit portal 2841,4828.

zones.name: Water altar
zones.note: members=No; exit portal 3495,4832.

zones.name: Yeti Town (Land of Snow)
zones.note: Yeti Town members=No, reached by the Land of Snow portal (2853,3461 -> 5024,9662). The Land of Snow page itself says members=Yes (the 2007 event area); I treat Yeti Town as F2P.

zones.name: Ashdale
zones.note: members=No; 'Ashdale contains the southernmost point on the map accessible in free-to-play'. Lodestone tile is on plane 2.

zones.name: City of Um
zones.note: members=No; F2P page lists 'Necromancy skill up to level 20 ... City of Um'. Lodestone 1083,1768 plane 1.

zones.name: Havenhythe: Wendlewick
zones.note: Havenhythe's western part is F2P (Free-to-play page: 'Havenhythe on 23 March 2026'), but it is a patchwork: Wendlewick fish farm, Moonsylvar Wood, Heathervein, Amberfell are members. The wiki maps Havenhythe at display coords (Wendlewick lodestone object 4164,3311 vs game tile 3461,1520), so I converted with offset (-703,-1791). Box is a GUESS-level core around Wendlewick (3481,1554) and the Shrine of Inanna (3557,1424).

members_holes.name: Fort Forinthry
members_holes.note: members=Yes; 'player-built fort north of the Jolly Boar Inn in the south-eastern part of the Wilderness'. Lodestone page: 'the only members-only lodestone to be located in the free-to-play part of the world' (3298,3528). Bounds from the walkable fort area in the bake.

members_holes.name: Woodcutters' Grove (south)
members_holes.note: members=Yes; map 3360,3544, 'just outside the east wall' of the fort.

members_holes.name: Woodcutters' Grove (north)
members_holes.note: members=Yes; northern tip of the grove area.

members_holes.name: Wilderness Agility Course
members_holes.note: members=Yes; map 2998,3949. 'Logging into the Wilderness agility course in a free to play world will now remove you from the area.'

members_holes.name: Heroes' Guild
members_holes.note: members=Yes; map square at 2910,3513 in Burthorpe.

members_holes.name: Mage Training Arena
members_holes.note: members=Yes; map 3363,3309 (inside the Al Kharid desert north of the pass).

members_holes.name: Edgeville Dungeon - Wilderness part (north)
members_holes.note: Wilderness page: 'the north part of Edgeville dungeon ... can be accessed by passing a members gate' (gate 3131-3132,9917/9918).

members_holes.name: Edgeville Dungeon - Wilderness part (gate side)
members_holes.note: South rows of the members section, east of the F2P giant-rat corridor.
